title: epf-stability: temporal (in)stability of day-ahead electricity-price-forecasting models
description: Code accompanying the article "Temporal (in)stability of day-ahead electricity-price-forecasting models: detection, attribution and forecast combination on the Polish market, with validation on two European markets". Leakage-free rolling walk-forward protocol, forecasting models (naive benchmarks, LEAR, gradient-boosted trees, recurrent networks, DNN, N-BEATSx, TFT), statistical evaluation and stability analyses. Code only; no data are distributed.
